name: rosifit-app-screenshot-capture
description: Deterministic, read-only Playwright capture of every screen/state in the RosiFit PWA (rosi-fit.vercel.app), with git-diff + DOM-fingerprint change detection, nav discovery and doc generation. No cleanup module: nothing is ever written.

scripts.test: node -r ts-node/register --test src/__tests__/glob.test.ts src/__tests__/fingerprint.test.ts src/__tests__/flow-loader.test.ts src/__tests__/flow-schema.test.ts src/__tests__/record-convert.test.ts src/__tests__/security-policy.test.ts src/__tests__/evidence-unit.test.ts src/__tests__/evidence-capture.test.ts src/__tests__/evidence-index.test.ts
